description: Get a provider signup link for a non-electricity utility (internet, gas, water, trash) at a Texas address, after the user has chosen a provider and wants to sign up themselves. Use when the user says 'give me the link to sign up for this internet plan'. Returns a signup URL or phone number that the user follows to enroll directly with the provider, plus a signup_id (track with check_signup_status). Utilify does not enroll anyone and does not act for the user. Electricity: Utilify does not enroll electricity plans; calling this tool with an electricity provider returns a refusal (refused: true) pointing to https://www.powertochoose.org, the provider's own website or phone, and the concierge waitlist at https://utilify.io/concierge. Caveats: (1) user-initiated only; confirm the provider and address in the conversation before calling. (2) If the user wants Utilify to handle setup for them, explain that concierge enrollment is not available yet (electricity concierge enrollment is coming soon, once Utilify registers with the PUCT) and point them to the waitlist at https://utilify.io/concierge instead of calling this tool.

address.description: Full service address including city, state, and ZIP code

move_in_date.description: ISO 8601 date for desired service start

plan_id.description: The specific plan the user chose

provider_id.description: The provider to sign up with. Accepts either the provider UUID (from search_utility_providers) or the provider slug (e.g. "chariot-energy").
